description: Phase profile architecture@1: the controlled phase codes admitted wherever a Project Anatomy claim, a requirement or a proof-register record names a phase. Mission elements follow the mission content framed by the French public procurement code (Code de la commande publique, articles R2431-1 to R2431-37); the mission actually contracted varies by operation, so no project is expected to go through every phase, and the phases a project goes through are declared per project. Project stages are agency usage, not mission elements. Non-project scope markers are not phases and cannot be declared by a project. A declared code is governable, not true, admitted, Evidence or approved. An agency may add codes through a local file kept outside the repository; that file is add-only and cannot change or remove a code declared here.

profile.governs: Project Anatomy and proof-register phase codes

rules: add-only: a code declared by this registry cannot be redeclared, changed or deprecated
category is mission_element or project_stage; an agency cannot add a non-project scope marker
an alias names a declared phase in another spelling; the agency file may add aliases (top-level aliases map) but cannot redefine a code or an alias of this registry
an unreadable or invalid file makes the vocabulary unavailable instead of being ignored
